item.text:
**Assessment**
Mixed, leaning slightly positive on service-delivery mechanics but negative on the broader governance mode. The best 2024 evidence shows technocratic targeting in health, social protection, and education. The main counter-evidence is patronage/dynastic politics and at least one concrete favoritism case in a development project, which weakens any claim that social services were consistently run by neutral professionals.

**Claims**
- [Indonesia](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/indonesia) - World Health Organization, 2024. WHO says Indonesia reached 90% coverage, lowered out-of-pocket costs, and improved access to essential health services regardless of gender, age, or disability. This is strong evidence of professionally managed, inclusive service delivery. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [Does Indonesia’s National Health Insurance Scheme mobile phone application, Mobile JKN, support health financing?](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893) - World Health Organization, 2024-12-06. WHO says JKN was built to expand access and financial protection, and Mobile JKN simplified enrollment and payments while lowering administrative costs. That points to technical, process-oriented management rather than patronage-based delivery. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- [BAPPENAS Perkuat Dukungan untuk Anak-Anak dan Keluarga Rentan](https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/id/press-releases/bappenas-perkuat-dukungan-untuk-anak-anak-dan-keluarga-rentan) - UNICEF Indonesia, 2024-04-25. Regsosek was used to improve targeting and delivery of social assistance for poor and vulnerable households, including children and families hit by shocks. This supports a technocratic welfare-administration reading. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [A Blueprint to Get Children Back to School in Indonesia](https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/stories/blueprint-get-children-back-school-indonesia) - UNICEF Indonesia, 2024-08-23. The back-to-school campaign returned nearly 37,000 children to learning and prevented about 149,000 dropouts since 2021. That is evidence of organized, professional service outreach for children. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [Report Launch Event: The Care Economy in Indonesia](https://www.worldbank.org/en/events/2024/08/28/report-launch-event-the-care-economy-in-indonesia) - World Bank, 2024-08-28. The care-economy roadmap framed care investment as a way to improve women’s labor-force participation and family wellbeing. This is positive evidence of policy design by specialists, though it is more roadmap than realized delivery. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.3`
- [Social Protection Inclusion in Indonesia’s Remote Areas - Identifying and Addressing Gaps and Challenges](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099062624071020814) - World Bank, 2024-06-01. The report says poor and vulnerable households in remote areas still faced barriers to accessing social protection. That is negative evidence of uneven management and incomplete professional reach. IDs: `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- [World Bank Group Debars PT LPPSLH Konsultan](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) - World Bank, 2024-07-10. The bank said the firm overbilled a project and improperly hired a project official’s family member. This is concrete evidence that favoritism and non-merit behavior persisted inside development implementation. IDs: `6B.4`, `5B.5`
- [Analysis: A Decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s Democracy Icon, Leaves Illiberal Legacy, Critics Say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. This is broad but relevant negative background for a claim that social services were insulated from patronage networks. IDs: `6B.4`, `5B.5`
- [Jokowi seeks Golkar takeover to retain decade-long influence](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/03/20/jokowi-seeks-golkar-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence) - Reuters via The Jakarta Post, 2024-03-20. Reuters reported efforts to install a loyal ally in Golkar and preserve influence after office, which supports a patronage-network reading rather than a purely professional public-service model. IDs: `6B.4`, `5B.5`

**Search gap**
Direct evidence on staffing decisions inside education, health, and social-protection bureaucracies is limited. The strongest positives are program-design and delivery evidence, while the strongest negatives are broader patronage signals plus one concrete favoritism case. I did not find a clean 2024 source proving that social-service ministries were systematically staffed by merit professionals rather than loyalists.
